Why Alcohol Detox Is Necessary

blocks.html: Alcohol affects the central nervous system. Over time, the body adjusts to its presence. When alcohol use suddenly stops, the body must readjust, which leads to withdrawal symptoms.

The Importance of Medical Detox for Alcohol

blocks.html: Unlike some other substances, alcohol withdrawal can quickly become severe. Symptoms such as seizures or delirium tremens require immediate medical attention.

blocks.html: This is why detox should never be attempted alone. A medically supervised environment provides the level of care needed to manage complications and prevent serious health risks.
